The '''Web Chasm''' is the lair of [[Spindel]]. It is a [[singles-plus combat]] [[dungeon]] located in the [[Ruins (east)|eastern ruins]] north of the [[Graveyard of Shadows]]. To enter the lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a Venenatis boss Slayer task (a spider Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). 

The entrance and lair itself is in level 29 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of [[player killers]] arriving.

[[File:Lesser wilderness bosses map.png|thumb|left|300px|The entrances to the lesser bosses' lairs.]]
Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across [[Callisto's Den]], [[Hunter's End]], the [[Skeletal Tomb]], [[Vet'ion's Rest]], the [[Silk Chasm]], the Web Chasm and the [[Escape Caves]]. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins.

Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Spindel, they will be unable to [[teleport]] for 3 [[ticks]] unless they have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].

In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
